name: AWS Database Migration Service
sku: AWS DMS replication instances and tasks.

ingest.cdc.note: After a migration, DMS can replicate ongoing changes to keep source and target in sync, using a replication server that reads from a source endpoint and writes to a target.

ingest.batch-extract.note: One-time full loads move relational databases, data warehouses and NoSQL stores into AWS. It is built for migration and replication rather than general-purpose extraction.

bands.note: Data validation compares each source row with its target row after a full load and as CDC changes arrive, and reports mismatches. It checks that data arrived intact, not user-defined business rules, and needs a primary key or unique index.

presentation.tagline: Managed database replication: full load plus ongoing change capture.
